- Security / legal: Anika Rao (security lead) — needs SOC2 evidence, data retention controls, KMS integration.
- Procurement: procurement@trustpath.ai — will handle contract/legal/PO.

3) Marissa (cc’d): please draft an internal enablement one-pager and short ROI bullets we can surface to Tom.

Attachments we’ll provide next: draft SOW, Redwood security brief, sample cost model. If you can share TrustPath procurement standard terms or an RFP doc that would speed review.

Proposed times for procurement + security bridge call: Tue 9/15 10:00–10:30am PT or Wed 9/16 1:00–1:30pm PT. Let me know what works.

Thanks — looking forward to keeping momentum.
